title: Preserve firmware55 and current bench state
decision: Continue host preservation, offline tooling and bounded read-only work within coordinator authorization.
rationale_and_scope: Do not change firmware, power, accounts, persistent settings, USB/SD or networking.

title: Resolve historical manual-dismiss instructions through evidence precedence
decision: The dialog is already cleared; no human intervention is pending.
rationale_and_scope: Later identity-guarded cleanup and visual attestation supersede ui_test.left_for_user_to_dismiss_with_ok and old README wiring/manual steps.
alternatives_not_selected: Carry forward stale manual OK requirement

title: Single hardware operator; preservation worker stays offline
decision: t14 is sole UART/camera owner for the current assignment; route live requests through t6.
rationale_and_scope: No UART, camera, CMU access or further delegation by this worker; all programs/files/communication through Herdr hc.
alternatives_not_selected: Second passive logger or helper on UART

title: Local Git allowlist and private original retention
decision: Track reviewed instructions, source/tools, plans, manifests, catalog and small sanitized derivatives.
rationale_and_scope: Ignore raw evidence, backups, state, original reference snapshots, environments/caches and private records; no remote and no identity change.

title: Keep byte-exact and recovery claims gated
decision: The original version.ini extraction remains a metadata reference; current remote metadata is a prerequisite only.
rationale_and_scope: New copied files need bounded frame completion, remote/host length+checksum and source stability. Full recovery and second-copy claims remain unproven.
alternatives_not_selected: Treat console-stripped extraction or host hash alone as verified backup

title: Preserve literal Mazda version requirements and scope
rationale_and_scope: Documented retrofit mismatch does not prove legacy USB/SD failure, identify exact hub, justify rewiring or authorize upgrade.
alternatives_not_selected: Diagnose all hub behavior as bad wiring

title: Keep physical-reference conflicts unresolved
decision: Preserve connector-view, hub1A, donor contact/fit and power dependencies in handoff.
rationale_and_scope: The AFK user will not press controls, move camera, insert media or wire anything; missing physical operations remain dependencies.
alternatives_not_selected: Assign manual bench actions to user
